title: The Knot Tied Too Tight
youtube_title: The Knot Tied Too Tight | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Una is tangled up with a parcel knot tied so tight it bit the paper and almost hides it. Una tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
